questions.stem: What is the difference between a food chain and a food web?

options.text: A food web shows a single pathway of energy transfer; a food chain shows multiple
A food chain shows a single pathway of energy transfer; a food web shows interconnected food chains
Food webs only include plants; food chains include animals

questions.explanation: A food chain shows a single linear pathway of energy transfer. A food web is more complex and shows how multiple food chains in an ecosystem are interconnected.
